text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are<n>walking
through the shopping district<n>on our way back from
an outing<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Hmm, what's that lovelyaroma? It smells like mellow,well-aged miso.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, miss! You've got a good<n>nose on ya! I
got some top-notch<n>miso delivered just the other
day.<n>Wanna buy a package and try some?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I'll take one! With that rich,<n>full-bodied aroma,
it's clearly been<n>aged to perfection. I bet you could
make a fabulous bowl of miso soup<n>with it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and test out my intuition! I<n>know a good
place where we can do<n>just that. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the miso soup, we head to a<n>nearby public
barbecue area.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Eating miso soup out in the open air<n>is bound to be
a très bien experience!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wowee! Howdy, you two! What're<n>the odds I'd
find y'all here?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You've come at the right time, Taiki.<n>I'm just about
to make some miso<n>soup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pardon? But isn't this spot for<n>barbecuin'?
What're you doin',<n>makin' miso soup out here?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Didn't you know? Miso soup<n>is a go-to dish
when camping! And do<n>you know why that is?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's because miso paste is made of<n>soybeans,
which can help lower your<n>cholesterol!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What's more, the enzymes in miso<n>help with
digestion!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's like a miracle food! I had<n>no idea!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It truly is a food with unlimited hidden<n>possibilities.
It's a wonder why it<n>isn't eaten all over the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So, how about it? Would you like a<n>bowl?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That there sure is a temptin' offer,<n>but seein' as
I've done eaten 'bout<n>two days worth of meat, I
don't think<n>I could even hold down a single sip.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's no reason to give up. Here,<n>close your eyes
for a moment... Start<n>the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After closing my eyes and<n>concentrating on the
relaxing music,<n>an image begins to pop into my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, can ya see it too, Trainer? This is<n>gettin' kinda
exciting, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's summon the souls of the<n>ingredients with the
music! First, let's<n>begin with the tofu—the angel in
the<n>world of miso!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Slice it with a smile. ♪ Warm it up all<n>the way
through! You're going to be<n>nice and velvety
smooth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next is the wakame seaweed, which<n>is brimming
with calcium and<n>magnesium! Let those nutrients
seep<n>right in the broth! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Time to let the broth dance and mingle<n>in the pot! ♪
Let the umami burst forth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And now it's time for a mash-up<n>between the broth
and the miso! ♪<n>Hand in hand, they raise the game!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the miso smells excellent! My<n>tummy may be
full but my mouth's<n>startin' to water...
choice_data_list: Is it almost done? I can't wait to have some!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, your excitement seems to be<n>matching the
ingredients'.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're not quite there yet! Crank up<n>that passion!
The secret to really<n>enjoying miso soup is to get
pumped<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Miso soup is THE BEST!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Really feel your body's craving forthe soup! C'mon, you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Ahh, it's starting to boil!<n>Show that miso
soup just how<n>excited you are!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Taiki
text_block_list.text: WOO-HOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... It's so weird. I thought I<n>was full, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This soup is so good, I can't stop<n>drinking it! It's
comforting, and goes<n>down so smoothly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That must mean you've synced up<n>nicely with the
miso soup. See,<n>doesn't it taste amazing?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's so delicious, I feel like I could<n>have another
million helpings! ♪ The<n>flavor of miso soup sure is
deep an'<n>complex!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm glad you understand the<n>wonder of miso
soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Miso soup—the superfood that<n>deserves to be
known across the<n>world!
choice_data_list: We need to spread the word!

Where did you learn how to make such good miso
soup?

soup?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Miso soup—the superfood that<n>deserves to be
known across the<n>world!
choice_data_list: We need to spread the word!
We need to spread the word!

Where did you learn how to make such good miso
soup?

Where did you learn how to make such good miso
soup?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Let's share the wonder of<n>miso soup with
everyone and make it<n>a beloved food around the
world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep exploring new ways to<n>make it, uncover
more possibilities,<n>and continue polishing our skill in
the<n>art of making miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl starts making<n>multiple batches of
miso soup to<n>explore as many possibilities as she
can.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't something I learned. I just<n>instinctively
season the soup based<n>on who I'm serving, so it
never<n>tastes the same twice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, the flavor is all the more<n>meaningful
precisely because it's a<n>once-in-a-lifetime
experience. Come,<n>let's savor this chance
encounter to<n>the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl takes a sip of the<n>miso soup and
relishes it with a calm,<n>almost saintly expression.
